user.title: Connect to a seat
user.description: The address of a seat you run (cliffvm) and a token for it. On the seat's machine, mint the token with `cliffvm token mint --sub owner --name "Home Assistant" --ttl 30d --secret-file SEAT-FOLDER/door.secret` and paste it here. Assist works with any token of the seat; the seat's calls into the house, the seat's sensors and its model select need the OWNER's token (the sub `owner`, or the one your seat's `operator` fact names). See docs/home-assistant.md.

reauth_confirm.title: The seat needs a new token
reauth_confirm.description: The seat at {url} refused Home Assistant's token (it ran out, or the seat's key changed), or this entry has no seat yet. Mint a new one on the seat (`cliffvm token mint --sub owner --ttl 30d --secret-file SEAT-FOLDER/door.secret`) and paste it here.

error.cannot_connect: The seat didn't answer at that address.
error.invalid_auth: The seat refused the token (wrong, expired, or from another seat).
error.invalid_url: That is not an http:// or https:// address.

send_message.name: Send a message to the seat
send_message.description: Hand the seat a message and do not wait for its answer (the seat answers in its own time, in its chat). The seat session is named by `session`.

session.name: Session
session.description: A name for the conversation; the same name continues the same seat session (default `service`).

ask.name: Ask the seat
ask.description: Ask the seat something and get its answer back as the service's response data (the answer and the session name). Runs a turn of the seat's model, which can take minutes.

session.name: Session
session.description: A name for the conversation; the same name continues the same seat session (default `service`).
